description: Send a file from the user's own computer into an app's public uploads, for a client that can run a command there (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor): an image, a video (.mp4 .m4v .mov .webm), audio or a document, up to 50 MB. Give the file name and its exact size_bytes, and sha256 when you can. Returns an upload_url and ready commands: one curl PUT for a file up to 32 MB, else a short Python script that sends 32 MB chunks with Content-Range and resumes after an interruption. Run the command on the computer that holds the file; the bytes never pass through the conversation. When the last byte arrives the file is at /api/uploads/<app_id>/<name>: a public address with no expiry, the same one UploadFile gives a page, to use in the app's pages or records. A file already there is never replaced: a name in use gets a short suffix, and the answer gives the address. Follow it with get_app_upload.

filename.description: The file's name with its extension, e.g. testimonial-1.mp4.

sha256.description: Optional hex sha256 of the file; a mismatch is refused.

size_bytes.description: The exact file size in bytes.
